Name: Alternate Anthro Andy - Furry Bear
Author: GrimLockeNX
Description:
[b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b]
Alternate Anthro Andy (AAA) turns [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s﻿ Andy into a big black bear. While technically not required, it was made to be used alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued (ACC)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22271]Furry Stardew Valley Expanded Continued[/url]﻿.﻿ This mod also allows you to change Andy's outfits in-game if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[b][size=4]Outfits
[/size][/b]This mod contains several different outfits that you can choose while in-game. However, the new overworld sprites and portraits might not load until you start a new day in-game (be it from sleeping or from quitting to title to reload).

The available outfits are:
[list]
[*]White Tanktop [HO]
[*]White T-Shirt [HOS]
[*]White Shirt [HOS]
[*]Strawberry-Red Shirt [HOS]
[*]Topless [HO]
[*]Lumberjack Shirt [H]
[*]Stripeless Lumberjack Shirt [H]
[*]Winter Coat [H]
[*]Winter Hoodie [H]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Outfit Options
[/size][/b]Each outfit might have more options for the head, overalls, and sleeve length. The options available for each outfits are denoted by the capital letters within the square brackets after the outfit's name. [H] means the outfit has options for either hair or hat, sometimes several variations of hat. [O] means the outfit has options for overalls. [S] means the outfit has options for sleeve lengths. 

[list=1]
[*][b][size=3]Head [H][/size][/b]
Allows you to choose between a head with hair only or one with a hat. There is technically only one hat but it can have two different symbols on it. One is a simple J-Symbol that was modeled after ACC Shane's. The other is a normal JOJA symbol, though it looks closer to one of the side character's JOJA hats than it does Andy's human JOJA hat.
Here are the available head options:
[list]
[*]Hair
[*]Plain Blue Hat
[*]J-Symbol Blue Hat
[*]Joja Blue Hat
[/list]

[*][size=3][b]Overalls [O][/b][/size]
Allows you to choose between different styles for Andy to wear his overalls, or if he even wears one. The 1 Suspender option will always have his left one slipped, like his human sprites. Choosing the No Overalls option will generally turn the overall into a long pair of trousers in the color of the overalls.
Here are the available overalls options:
[list]
[*]No Overalls
[*]1 Suspender (left side slipped)
[*]2 Suspenders (properly worn)
[/list]

[*][b][size=3]Sleeve Length [S][/size][/b]
Allows you to choose between different sleeve lengths for some outfits.
Here are the available sleeve options:
[list]
[*]Short Sleeves
[*]Long Sleeves
[/list][/list]

[b][size=4]Seasonal Outfits
[/size][/b]By default, the mod will only have a single (Basic) outfit for Spring, Summer, and Fall. It will, however, change to a unique Winter Outfit like the vanilla game.

To enable separate outfits for each seasons, enable the option Seasonal Outfits from the config menu. Enabling that option will disable the Basic Outfit and makes the game use different outfits for Spring, Summer, and Fall. Each Outfits have its own category in the config menu and you can set each Head, Overalls, and Sleeve options separately.

These are the default outfits in this mod:
[list]
[*][b]Basic: [/b]White Tanktop + Slipped Overalls (1 Suspender) + JOJA Blue Hat
[*][b]Winter: [/b]Winter Coat + Hair
[*][b]Spring:[/b] White T-Shirt + Properly Worn Overalls (2 Suspenders) + J-Symbol Blue Hat
[*][b]Summer:[/b] Topless + Slipped Overalls (1 Suspender) + JOJA Blue Hat
[*][b]Fall:[/b] Lumberjack Shirt + Plain Blue Hat
[/list]
[b][size=4]Other Options
[/size][/b]These are the other, non-clothing choosing, options available in this mod:
[list]
[*][b]Alternative Expression 9 Eyes:[/b] By default, Andy's expression 9 eyes (his embarassed/sad(?) expression) will have his eyes closed. Enabling this option will make Andy's expression 9 eyes to be open and looking to the side when he's not wearing his hat. When he's wearing his hat, his eyes will remain hidden as he pulls his hat down.
[*][b]Seasonal Outfits:[/b] This option will make Andy's outfits to change with each seasons. Basic Outfit will not be used, instead the outfits for each season will be set separately. May need a new day in-game to be applied.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*](Optional) Install﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]﻿
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22271]Furry Stardew Valley Expanded Continued[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod's file
[*]Extract the downloaded file into your Stardew Valley's "mods" folder (so it becomes [Stardew Valley game folder]/mods/AltAnthroAndy)
[/list]
[b][size=3]Other Notes[/size][/b]
As Andy is a bear here it takes a lot of inspiration from ACC Liam's overworld sprites and portraits. It also takes a lot of inspiration from ACC Shane for the hat, from ACC Clint for the beard, and from ACC Lewis for the mustache. So massive thanks to Gaveliere, sion9000, and everyone else that worked on Anthro Characters Continued!
Of course, this mod is just a re-sprite of Andy from Stardew Valley Expanded, so thanks to FlashShifter, Hopewashere, and everyone that worked on it!
Also, the lumberjack look was mostly inspired from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE﻿[/url] by Poltergeister. It was also massively helpful to have another interpretation for the sprites when I was confused on how to interpret a few of them.
